programme.title: South to Black Power
programme.desc: Author and columnist Charles M. Blow calls for African Americans to migrate to the South to upend the political power structure and reclaim the land and culture they left behind.

programme.title: The Soul of America
programme.desc: Writer, journalist, historian and presidential biographer Jon Meacham offers his timely and invaluable insights into the United States' current political and historical moment by examining its past struggles with racism, sexism and xenophobia.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people.

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he must prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: After his son is tricked into awakening a cursed Chinese emperor, Rick O'Connell and his family seek a way to send the megalomaniac and his 10,000 warriors back to their graves.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: A couple is shocked when their missing daughter is returned to them after disappearing eight years earlier. However, what should be a joyful family reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

programme.title: Miss You, Love You
programme.desc: A blunt, grieving widow is forced to plan her husband's funeral with a total stranger: her estranged son's assistant.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: A high-powered CEO puts her career and family on the line when she begins a torrid affair with her much younger intern.

programme.title: Martin Lawrence: You So Crazy
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence performs his stand-up comedy routine in a concert recorded at Brooklyn's Majestic Theatre.

programme.title: Nine Lives
programme.desc: A workaholic billionaire tries to communicate with his family when a bizarre turn of events traps him inside the body of a cat named Mr. Fuzzypants.

programme.title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story (New)
programme.desc: Explore the rise of a boundary-pushing, sex-positive, cable-access pioneer who became an accidental AIDS-era lifeline and First Amendment fighter; at 70, with 600 shows behind her, she considers her place in the history she created.

programme.title: How We Get Free
programme.desc: Over the course of two years, Elisabeth Epps works to end cash bail on all fronts, from bailing people out of jail to running for office as one of the first abolitionist candidates in Colorado.

programme.title: Music Box: Yacht Rock: A Dockumentary
programme.desc: Chronicling the emergence and popularity of the West Coast, soft rock pop culture epitomized by musical artists such as Christopher Cross, Michael McDonald, Kenny Loggins, Steely Dan and Toto.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: Hunted by the warrior Sub-Zero, MMA fighter Cole Young finds sanctuary at the temple of Lord Raiden. Training with experienced fighters and a rogue mercenary, Cole prepares to stand with Earth's greatest champions to battle the enemies from Outworld.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Annihilation
programme.desc: A group of martial-arts warriors has only six days to save the Earth from an extradimensional invasion.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Scorpion's Revenge
programme.desc: The champions of Outworld and Earthrealm fight to the death in a brutal tournament that determines the fate of Earth.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Battle of the Realms
programme.desc: The heroes must travel to Outworld to defend Earthrealm as Scorpion searches for the ancient Kamidogu before it's used to resurrect the One Being.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Snow Blind
programme.desc: When Kano and Black Dragon mercenaries become determined to take over Earthrealm, undisciplined Kenshi seeks tutelage from retired Kuai Liang to stop Kano from decimating all of Earthrealm.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Cage Match
programme.desc: Action superstar Johnny Cage squares off against a sinister secret society that's plotting a nefarious scheme. However, the brutal fight against the bloodthirsty warriors of the Netherrealm is just the beginning.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: Hunted by the warrior Sub-Zero, MMA fighter Cole Young finds sanctuary at the temple of Lord Raiden. Training with experienced fighters and a rogue mercenary, Cole prepares to stand with Earth's greatest champions to battle the enemies from Outworld.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: When all but one child from the same classroom mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: Game Night
programme.desc: A couple's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when their friends agree to participate in a murder mystery party. They soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: Cat is a solitary animal, but as its home is devastated by a great flood, he finds refuge on a boat populated by various species, and will have to team up with them despite their differences.

programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
programme.desc: A self-styled Lothario (Ryan Gosling) teaches a suddenly single 40-something (Steve Carell) how to be a hit with the ladies.

programme.title: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
programme.desc: Reconstructing the nine days following the disaster in forensic, real-time detail, from the control-room engineers fighting to prevent a total meltdown, to the political leaders confronting the unthinkable, to ordinary citizens caught in the fallout.

programme.title: Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That's the Weight of the World)
programme.desc: Directed by Ahmir Questlove Thompson, exploring the musical origins and lasting cultural impact of Earth, Wind and Fire.

programme.title: The Lionheart
programme.desc: In 2011, two-time Indianapolis 500 champion Dan Wheldon died in a horrific crash at the Las Vegas Motor Speedway, shaking the world of motorsports to its core. Ten years later, Dan's two sons, Sebastian and Oliver, follow in their father's footsteps.

programme.title: John Wick
programme.desc: New York City becomes the bullet-riddled playground of a former assassin (Keanu Reeves) as he hunts down the Russian mobsters who destroyed everything he held dear.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Legendary hit man John Wick comes out of retirement when a former associate plots to seize control of an international assassins' guild. Bound by a blood oath to help him, Wick travels to Rome to square off against the world's deadliest killers.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
programme.desc: Stripped of the High Table's protective services, legendary hit man John Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as the world's most ruthless killers try to collect the $14 million bounty on his head.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
programme.desc: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin.

Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups. (Baseball)

programme.title: The Leadoff Spot (Live)
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel. (Sports talk, Talk)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.title: Charlotte's Web
programme.desc: After learning that a young pig's days are numbered, a literate spider (Julia Roberts) weaves an elaborate plan to save her friend from the butcher's block. - Dakota Fanning, Kevin Anderson, Gary Basaraba, Beau Bridges, Essie Davis (Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. - Zachary Levi, Josh Duhamel, Quentin Plair, Terrence Terrell, Marshall Cook (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: Blue Eyed Girl
programme.desc: Summoned home to visit her two sisters and her ailing father, a woman starts to re-evaluate her life as she wonders what could have been. - Marisa Coughlan, Beau Bridges, Eliza Coupe, Freddy Rodriguez, Sam Trammell (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average. - Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael is on his daily commute home, which quickly becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a mysterious stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a deadly plan is unfolding, and he is unwittingly caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train. - Liam Neeson, Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson, Jonathan Banks, Sam Neill (Thriller, Mystery, Action)

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. - Zachary Levi, Josh Duhamel, Quentin Plair, Terrence Terrell, Marshall Cook (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: Dante (Brian O'Halloran) is called in to cover a shift at his New Jersey convenience store on his day off. His friend Randal (Jeff Anderson) helps him pass the time, neglecting his video-store customers next door to hang out in the Quick Stop. The uneventful day is disrupted by news that one of Dante's ex-girlfriends has died. After attending her memorial service, Dante muses over staying with current girlfriend Veronica (Marilyn Ghigliotti) or reuniting with ex Caitlin (Lisa Spoonhauer). - Brian O'Halloran, Jeff Anderson, Marilyn Ghigliotti, Lisa Spoonhauer, Jason Mewes (Comedy)

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Ignacio (Jack Black), or Nacho to his friends, works as a cook in the Mexican monastery where he grew up. The monastery is home to a host of orphans whom Nacho cares for deeply, but there is not much money to feed them properly. Nacho decides to raise money for the children by moonlighting as a Lucha Libre wrestler with his partner Esqueleto (Héctor Jiménez), but since the church forbids Lucha, Nacho must disguise his identity. - Jack Black, Ana de la Reguera, Héctor Jiménez, Richard Montoya, Peter Stormare (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever. - Katherine Heigl, Tom Wilkinson, Linda Emond, Grace Gummer, Alexis Bledel (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ, Drama)

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened. - Christina Ricci, Colleen Camp, Lew Temple, Nick Vallelonga, Santino Barnard (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Carriers
programme.desc: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe. - Lou Taylor Pucci, Chris Pine, Piper Perabo, Emily VanCamp, Christopher Meloni (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces. - Aldis Hodge, Edwin Hodge, Danielle Deadwyler (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Certain Women
programme.desc: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer who finds herself contending with both office sexism and a hostage situation; a wife and mother whose determination to build her dream home puts her at odds with the men in her life; and a young law student who forms an ambiguous bond with a lonely ranch hand. - Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams, Rene Auberjonois, Jared Harris (Drama)

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. - Garrett Hedlund, Hamish Linklater, Brittany Snow, Christian Convery, Tramell Tillman (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s). - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul. - Orlando Bloom, Caitriona Balfe, John Turturro, Clare Dunne, Gary Beadle (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: A transplanted New Yorker attempting to acclimate to Los Angeles, Mike Peters (Jon Favreau), is struggling to both boost his comedy career and get over his last relationship. A self-proclaimed master of seduction, Mike's buddy, Trent Walker (Vince Vaughn), tries to show him how to make connections and get the attention of women. Slowly moving toward regaining his confidence, Mike meets the gorgeous and down-to-earth Lorraine (Heather Graham), sparking a welcome new romance. - Jon Favreau, Vince Vaughn, Ron Livingston, Patrick Van Horn, Alex Désert (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces. - Aldis Hodge, Edwin Hodge, Danielle Deadwyler (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
programme.desc: Faced with their biggest challenge yet, the gang sets out to honor a lost pal, only to find themselves in the middle of where it all began -- spring break. They soon learn their old school ways of partying can hardly compete with today's generation. - Dan Bakkedahl, Kevin Dillon, Josh Duhamel, James Roday Rodriguez, Nick Swardson (Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly. (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s). - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull." (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Georgina Cates, Greg Harris, Spike Jonze (Comedy)

programme.title: Eric Clapton: Life in 12 Bars
programme.desc: Eric Clapton is the only ever three-time-inductee to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, is an 18-time Grammy Award winner and widely renowned as one of the greatest performers of all time. But behind the scenes is restlessness and tragedy. Clapton's quest to grow his artistic voice left fans surprised as he constantly quit successful bands. His isolated pursuit of his craft, and fear of selling out, served as a catalyst for his evolution as an artist. (Documentary, Music, Blues, Rock)

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past. - Tim Blake Nelson, Glenn Plummer, Andrew Liner, Kevin Corrigan, Nina Arianda (Drama)

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: After his father's demise, Charlie Price inherits the family business, a shoe factory in Northampton, England. He is not interested in shoes, and the factory is in such dire financial straits that he must lay off 15 employees. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers. - Joel Edgerton, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Sarah-Jane Potts, Jemima Rooper, Linda Bassett (Comedy drama, LGBTQ, Music)

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis. - Seth Green, Breckin Meyer, Brenda Song, Clare Grant, Macaulay Culkin (Comedy drama)

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. - Elias Koteas, Briana Middleton, Bridget Wareham, Justin Nurse, Reuben Frederick Gear (Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Road Trip
programme.desc: Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Discovering the mistake, he tows two of his college buddies -- and one not-so-eager kid who happens to own the car -- on a raucous 1,800-mile road trip from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin, Texas, to save his lifelong romance. - Seann William Scott, Breckin Meyer, D.J. Qualls, Fred Ward, Andy Dick (Comedy)

programme.title: Río
programme.desc: Captured by smugglers when he was just a hatchling, a macaw named Blu never learned to fly and lives a happily domesticated life in Minnesota with his human friend, Linda. Blu is thought to be the last of his kind, but when word comes that Jewel, a lone female, lives in Rio de Janeiro, Blu and Linda go to meet her. Animal smugglers kidnap Blu and Jewel, but the pair soon escape and begin a perilous adventure back to freedom -- and Linda. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Musical)

programme.title: Imagine That
programme.desc: Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. - Eddie Murphy, Thomas Haden Church, Yara Shahidi, Nicole Ari Parker, Ronny Cox (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama)

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: After his father's demise, Charlie Price inherits the family business, a shoe factory in Northampton, England. He is not interested in shoes, and the factory is in such dire financial straits that he must lay off 15 employees. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers. - Joel Edgerton, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Sarah-Jane Potts, Jemima Rooper, Linda Bassett (Comedy drama, LGBTQ, Music)

programme.title: City of God
programme.desc: In the poverty-stricken favelas of Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, two young men choose different paths. Rocket (Phellipe Haagensen) is a budding photographer who documents the increasing drug-related violence of his neighborhood. José "Zé" Pequeno (Douglas Silva) is an ambitious drug dealer who uses Rocket and his photos as a way to increase his fame as a turf war erupts with his rival, "Knockout Ned" (Leandro Firmino da Hora). The film was shot on location in Rio's poorest neighborhoods. - Alexandre Rodrigues, Leandro Firmino da Hora, Phellipe Haagensen, Douglas Silva, Jonathan Haagensen (Crime drama, Drama)

programme.title: City of Men
programme.desc: Childhood friends Ace (Douglas Silva) and Wallace (Darlan Cunha) are both approaching their 18th birthdays. Ace struggles to raise his son alone after the mother takes a job in São Paulo, while Wallace embarks on a search for his long-missing father (Rodrigo dos Santos), whom he eventually finds having just finished serving 15 years in prison. Newly discovered secrets about the past will test Ace and Wallace's friendship as they find themselves on opposite sides of a gang war. - Douglas Silva, Darlan Cunha, Jonathan Haagensen, Rodrigo dos Santos, Eduardo BR (Drama, Crime drama)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Unholy Alliances
programme.desc: S1E10 - When governments strike dark deals with cults, mobs and even sworn enemies, frosty relationships and mounting tensions are tested head on. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Bizarre Weapons
programme.desc: S2E5 - Desperation breeds invention, and not all of it conventional; from a British scheme to launch airborne balloons against Nazi Germany, to American bats fitted with incendiary devices, to a covert effort to manipulate monsoon rains in Vietnam, newly unearthed documents reveal how far nations were willing to bend reality to their will; in the risky calculus of war, nothing is too strange to try. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Buried Secrets
programme.desc: S2E3 - David Duchovny exposes a clandestine nuclear blast set off deep below Mississippi soil, secret experiments conducted on citizens in the New York subway system, and a wartime bunker built to trap British spies underground during a Nazi invasion. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Top Secret Sites
programme.desc: S2E2 - Step inside hidden areas where history was steered in secret, from Churchill's wartime bunker, complete with a direct line to FDR concealed inside his private bathroom, to a Soviet weapons base in the desert exposed only by a daring U-2 spy mission. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Secrets of the Skies
programme.desc: S1E1 - Uncovering a plane crash in North Carolina that almost triggered nuclear Armageddon; the story of a UFO attack on a U.S. missile base that was suppressed for decades; a daring Israeli heist to steal a cutting-edge fighter jet. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Spy Tech
programme.desc: S1E9 - From the seemingly innocuous children's toy engineered to save an informant, to hirsute-inspired movie disguises, the government's most clandestine inventions are never what one would suspect, and that's exactly why no one never saw them coming. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Deep Cover
programme.desc: S1E6 - Undercover smokescreens driven by daring agents in service of executing a greater purpose. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Covert Heists
programme.desc: S2E13 - Sometimes when governments can't negotiate their way to victory, they steal it; when the KGB sets its sights on a NATO missile, they enlist a smooth-talking German playboy armed with only a wheelbarrow, a carpet and a postage stamp; an Israeli covert operation hijacks 200 tons of uranium on the high seas to fuel a secret nuclear arsenal, while during WWII, the Allies deploy a female agent to steal top-secret naval codes, solely with seductive charm. (Documentary)

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - High Strangeness (New)
programme.desc: S2E14 - When conventional tactics fail, governments have been known to test the boundaries of reality; in the darkest days of World War II, Britain turns to an astrologer who claims he can alter the course of war using the power of the stars; in the jungles of Vietnam, U.S. forces turn to dowsing rods and ancient mystical practices to locate enemies hidden underground. (Documentary)

programme.title: Ancient Aliens - Alien A.I. (New)
programme.desc: S22E11 - Examining how researchers use artificial intelligence to analyze historical data and evaluate claims of extraterrestrial activity. - Giorgio A. Tsoukalos, Erich von Däniken, David Childress, William Henry, Linda Moulton Howe (Documentary, History, Paranormal)

programme.title: Ancient Aliens - UFO Sightings
programme.desc: S22E10 - Host Giorgio Tsoukalos probes the series archives to present the most compelling UFO SIGHTINGS. From footage of extraordinary aircraft taken by fighter pilots to a strange object filmed flying over a military base in Iraq and mysterious glowing orbs that are reported all over the world, are these remarkable sightings evidence of extraterrestrial visitation? - Giorgio A. Tsoukalos, Erich von Däniken, David Childress, William Henry, Linda Moulton Howe (Documentary, History, Paranormal)

programme.desc: Chef Primo and businessman Secondo are immigrant brothers from Italy who open their dream restaurant, Paradise, in New Jersey. However, Primo's authentic food is too unfamiliar for the local tastes, and the restaurant is struggling. When famous Italian-American bandleader Louis Prima is scheduled to appear at Paradise, the two brothers put all of their efforts into the important meal, which will likely decide the fate of their restaurant. - Minnie Driver, Ian Holm, Isabella Rossellini, Tony Shalhoub, Stanley Tucci (Drama)

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret. - Richard Gere, Jennifer Lopez, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Lisa Ann Walter (Romantic comedy, Drama, Music)

programme.title: Anything Else
programme.desc: A writer (Jason Biggs) has problems with his live-in girlfriend (Christina Ricci) and an obsessive teacher (Woody Allen) with a history of mental illness. - Woody Allen, Jason Biggs, Christina Ricci, Danny DeVito, Stockard Channing (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, "Beat" Takeshi Kitano, Michael Carmen Pitt, Juliette Binoche (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara, Beverly D'Angelo, Ian Anthony Dale (Drama)

programme.title: The Sense of an Ending
programme.desc: A business owner (Jim Broadbent) reunites with his first love (Charlotte Rampling) after a letter and a diary force him to confront the past. - Jim Broadbent, Charlotte Rampling, Harriet Walter, Michelle Dockery, Matthew Goode (Drama)

programme.title: Cusp
programme.desc: In a small military town in Texas, three spirited teenage girls live out a fever-dream summer. Through their characters, photographers and debut filmmakers Parker Hill and Isabel Bethencourt share a fascinating glimpse into authentic American girlhood, where the strictures of adolescence clash with the growing desire for personal agency. (Documentary)

programme.title: Backcountry
programme.desc: A couple (Missy Peregrym, Jeff Roop) on a deep-wilderness hike become hopelessly lost within an aggressive black bear's territory. - Missy Peregrym, Jeff Roop, Eric Balfour, Nicholas Campbell, Melanie Mullen (Adventure, Drama, Thriller, Horror, Action)

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them. - Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan, Rosario Dawson, Michael Chiklis, Anthony Mackie (Family, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden. - Kevin James, Christina Ricci, Luis Guzmán, Melissa Leo, Francis Cronin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are. - Deanna Jarvis, Derick Agyemang, Kylee Evans, Jonathan Goad, Ish Morris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Violent Heart
programme.desc: Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart. - Jovan Adepo, Grace Van Patten, Lukas Haas, Mary J. Blige, Kimberly Williams-Paisley (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: L Word Mississippi: Hate the Sin
programme.desc: Exploring the lives of gay women living in the conservative, religious deep South and the unique hardships, bigotry, bullying, sexism and racism they endure. (Special, Documentary, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden. - Kevin James, Christina Ricci, Luis Guzmán, Melissa Leo, Francis Cronin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Four Letters of Love
programme.desc: Nicholas and Isabel are made for each other, but as destiny pulls them together, family, passion and faith drives them apart. As they embark on journeys of heartache and misplaced love, fate soon contrives to pull the threads of their lives together. - Pierce Brosnan, Helena Bonham Carter, Gabriel Byrne, Ann Skelly, Fionn O'Shea (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity. - John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. - Matthew McConaughey, Sarah Jessica Parker, Zooey Deschanel, Justin Bartha, Bradley Cooper (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Queen Bees
programme.desc: While her house undergoes repairs, fiercely independent senior Helen temporarily moves into a nearby retirement community, where she encounters lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments and a hotbed of bullying "mean girls." - Ellen Burstyn, James Caan, Ann-Margret, Jane Curtin, Loretta Devine (Comedy)

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band. - Zoe Lister-Jones, Adam Pally, Fred Armisen, Susie Essman, Hannah Simone (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Like many Americans, average suburbanite Don Truby and his 15-year-old son use the Internet for information, communication and viewing pornography. Don's son Chris also maintains sexually explicit conversations with classmate Hannah, an aspiring actress whose mother posts pictures of her daughter on a modeling Website. In sharp contrast, overprotective mom Patricia Beltmeyer does everything in her power to protect her daughter from the digital age. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer, Dean Norris, Adam Sandler (Drama)

programme.title: Peep World
programme.desc: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday. - Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman, Rainn Wilson, Judy Greer, Kate Mara (Comedy)

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning. - Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh, Natasha Lyonne, Paul Hipp, Anita Pallenberg (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: La Madrina: The Savage Life of Lorine Padilla
programme.desc: Lorine Padilla joins a street gang in the Bronx, N.Y., before becoming an activist and spiritual adviser. (Documentary)

programme.title: She's All That
programme.desc: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Rachael Leigh Cook, Matthew Lillard, Paul Walker, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Irena's Vow
programme.desc: Caught in a German roundup to be used as a slave laborer, Polish nurse Irena Gut becomes a German army major's housekeeper during World War II. Irena risks her life to conceal a dozen Jews within the major's home. - Sophie Nélisse, Dougray Scott, Andrzej Seweryn, Maciej Nawrocki, Aleksandar Milićević (War, Docudrama)

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs. - Barbra Streisand, Seth Rogen, Brett Cullen, Colin Hanks, Adam Scott (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. - Jason Segel, Dakota Johnson, Casey Affleck, Isabella Kai Rice, Violet McGraw (Drama)

programme.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
programme.desc: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. - Jennifer Garner, Maika Monroe, Cody Fern, Noah Silver, Justin Kirk (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Certain Women
programme.desc: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer who finds herself contending with both office sexism and a hostage situation; a wife and mother whose determination to build her dream home puts her at odds with the men in her life; and a young law student who forms an ambiguous bond with a lonely ranch hand. - Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams, Rene Auberjonois, Jared Harris (Drama)

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past. - Jessica Chastain, Peter Sarsgaard, Brooke Timber, Ross Brodar, Josh Charles (Drama)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation. - Harrison Ford, Kelly McGillis, Alexander Godunov, Josef Sommer, Lukas Haas (Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. - Matt Damon, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Cate Blanchett, Philip Seymour Hoffman (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance)

programme.desc: S2E18 - Nonny is on a quest to become a real knight. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.desc: S5E25 - Skipper Molly and First Mate Gil are shipwrecked on Volcano Island, and it's about to erupt; parts of their boat start to mysteriously disappear. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.desc: S6E20 - When giant robot Buster steals all the batteries that power Solar City, which runs on the sun's energy, it's up to solar power workers Nonny and Goby to stop him and get the lights back on before the big light show is cancelled. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Bubble Bee-athalon!
programme.desc: S3E15 - The Guppies must work together to turn nectar into honey for the queen bee's tea time. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Glitter Games!
programme.desc: S4E1 - Molly helps a princess-in-training with her manners, and together they become princesses in the hallowed Glitter Games. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Don't Yuck My Yum!
programme.desc: S6E17 - In the Gourmet Galaxy, everyone loves yummy food, but when Gen. Yuck turns everything icky, only a recipe for delicious moon muffins can stop her; master chef Goby and his apprentice, Deema, must bake those muffins and save the galaxy. - Catherine Bradley, Caleb Clark, Leah Janvier, AJ Kane, Nirvaan Pal (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: S4E2 - Gabby and friends go all out for an extra special holiday, throwing a "paw-tastic" party, complete with homemade decorations and dessert. (Children, Fantasy, Animated)

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Fluffy Flufferton

programme.desc: S5E6 - Goby and Gil go on a quest to get a geode at the top of a volcano, then try to make it back to the Rocky Valley Rock Show in time to enter the contest for best rock. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Spring Chicken Is Coming
programme.desc: S1E13 - The Bubble Guppies must grow a flower for the Spring Chicken. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Dollhouse Fairy Tales
programme.desc: S4E7 - Tall tales come to life with a king, a mermaid and so much more as Gabby and the gang create and celebrate enchanting fairytales in a storybook castle. (Children, Fantasy, Animated)

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: S5E2 - Gabby and Pandy blast off to Planet Caturn after CatRat gets stuck there looking for space cheese. (Children, Fantasy, Animated)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Piggy in the Middle; Pancakes; Thunderstorm; Daddy's Movie; Bicycles
programme.desc: Peppa teases George; Mummy Pig makes pancakes; Peppa and George hear a strange noise; Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera; Peppa's friends ride their bicycles. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Mountain Climbing; Trampolines; Skateboarding; Hoops; Soft Play
programme.desc: Grampy Rabbit teaches mountain climbing; Peppa goes to a trampoline park; Peppa and George play with their skateboards; Madame Gazelle and the class workout; Grandpa Pig takes Peppa sailing. - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Vet Clinic; The Crew Builds a Mermaid Party
programme.desc: S3E1 - When the traveling veterinarian Dr. Diwa can't finish all her checkups in Builder Cove in time, Rubble and crew know just what to do; Lily's mermaid-themed birthday party is called off when it starts to rain. - Leslie Adlam, Jonathan Tan, Shazdeh Kapadia, Sabrina Jalees, Martin Roach (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Giant Dam; The Crew Builds a Squirrel-Proof Farm
programme.desc: S1E23 - Rubble & Crew are on the job to save Builder Cove after a rainstorm threatens to flood the town; Rubble and Motor come up with crafty construction solutions to fix Farmer Zoe's squirrel problem before the Farm Fair. - Leslie Adlam, Jonathan Tan, Shazdeh Kapadia, Sabrina Jalees, Martin Roach (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile - Stuck On You; Pest Friend
programme.desc: S1E13 - Daisy worries she and Winston will be stuck together forever when they get tangled in his jump rope; Daisy and Mr. Crocodile try to help Roland find a best friend to take to an acorn show. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Ultimate Rescue: Pups Stop a Meltdown; Ultimate Rescue: Pups and the Mystery of the Missing Cellphones
programme.desc: S6E2 - Things begin to melt during a hot day, and the pups will need a lot of fire-pup power to cool things down; cell phones vanish all over Adventure Bay. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Mighty Pups vs. the Big Chill; Mighty Pups vs. the Mighty Cheetah
programme.desc: S10E16 - Harold creates a ray that can freeze things instantly, it goes awry and sends a giant ice ball toward Adventure Bay; the Cheetah snatches half of Chase's Meteor Crystal, Chase must stop the Cheetah and restore his crystal. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Moto Pups: Pups Save the Donuts; Moto Pups: Pups Save the Kitties
programme.desc: S7E22 - When the Ruff-Ruff Pack steals Mr. Porter's mini-donut maker, the Moto Pups set off to get the machine back in one piece; the Ruff-Ruff Pack takes over Humdinger's lair and runs off with his kitties. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Tooth Fairy; Pups Solve the Mystery of the Missing Art
programme.desc: S9E7 - Julius loses his tooth and has a dream that the PAW Patrol saves a bumbling tooth fairy; when all the paintings mysteriously disappear from the Art Museum Festival, the PAW Patrol must solve the missing art mystery and return all the paintings. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile - Goodbye Goosey; Croc Forgot
programme.desc: S2E3 - Daisy gives Freddy and Teddy an old favorite toy, but then decides she wants it back; Mr. Crocodile comes up with a genius system to remember things but can't remember how it works. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Bears; Pups Save a Farmerless Farm
programme.desc: S6E17 - The PAW Patrol works quietly to save sleeping bears and return them to their cave; with the farmers out of town, Mayor Goodway calls the PAW Patrol to wrangle animals and control the chaos on a farmerless farm. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Hiding Elephants; Pups Save a Yodeler
programme.desc: S8E7 - Elephants become trapped in the Monkey Temple after a bee frightens them away from their watering hole; Wingnut runs away from wolves that are attracted to his yodeling and he ends up trapped in a canyon. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save Katie and Some Kitties; Pups Save a Helo Humdinger
programme.desc: S9E17 - When Mayor Humdinger tricks Katie into watching his kitties, an alarm system is set off and the PAW Patrol must rescue them; when Mayor Humdinger swipes one of Ryder's early inventions he must be rescued from an out-of-control flight. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Melon Festival; Pups Save a Cow
programme.desc: S6E3 - Mayor Humdinger's plan to win the giant melon contest goes off the rails when his "melon" bounces away and causes chaos all over town; Farmer Al's truck gets stuck on a broken bridge. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Marooned Mayors; Pups Save the Game Show
programme.desc: S7E15 - While ice fishing in the North Country, Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger get stuck in an ice crevasse; Beryl hosts a game show at the Wingnuts' farm. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Mountain Surfers; Pups Save Humdinger's Home Away From Home
programme.desc: S11E7 - A mighty wind sweeps Zuma and Harrigan off the beach and blows them all the way up to Jake's Mountain; Humdinger's driving lands him and his trailer at the top of a tall spire. (Animated, Children, Educational, Adventure)

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile - Finders Keepers; Dancing Croc
programme.desc: S1E10 - Mr. Crocodile takes the motto finders, keepers a bit too far; Daisy and Mr. Crocodile arrange a dance performance for Mrs. Flores after they find her old dance shoes. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Spring; Miss Rabbit's Helicopter; Baby Alexander; Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse; Miss Rabbit's Day Off
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig organizes an egg hunt; Miss Rabbit takes Peppa's family for a ride; Peppa's cousin visits; Grandpa Pig takes everyone to visit the lighthouse; Miss Rabbit hurts her ankle. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Recycling; The Boat Pond; Traffic Jam; Bedtime; Sports Day
programme.desc: Peppa and George tidy up; Peppa's family goes to the pond; Granny and Grandpa Pig invite Peppa to lunch; Peppa and George still want to play at bedtime; sports day. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Igloo; Clouds; Mr Bull Digs Up the River; Little Swift
programme.desc: It's a snowy day, and Peppa's family build a snowman and an igloo; Mummy, Daddy, Peppa, and George go to the seaside; Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George for a day on his boat; Peppa and her family take a sick Swift to the vet. - Amelie Bea Smith (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Dinosaur is Lost; Muddy Puddles; Fancy Dress Party; Camping; Very Hot Day
programme.desc: Mr. Dinosaur is George's favorite toy; the rain makes Peppa sad; Peppa and George have a fancy dress party; Peppa and her family go camping; Peppa and George want to jump in mud puddles. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile - Just Gigi; Croc N Seek
programme.desc: S2E5 - Daisy and Mr. Crocodile assume Gigi is lonely and try to spend every minute with her; Mr. Crocodile hides Teddy's stuffed animal during hide and seek, but then can't find it anywhere. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Amusement Parking Lot!
programme.desc: S3E10 - The children try to figure out how to get Mr. Grouper's car started after it breaks down on the way to an amusement park. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - Space Guppies!
programme.desc: S4E7 - When the evil robot Major Bummer tries to eliminate music from the galaxy, Princess Molly and the Guppies must restore peace, harmony and melody. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Bubble Guppies - The Running of the Bullfrogs!
programme.desc: S3E22 - Gil and Goby bring a tadpole to school to watch him grow into a frog. (Animated, Children, Educational)

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas - Breaking Bubba
programme.desc: S2E18 - The bidders arrive in Arlington, Texas; Ricky and Bubba go the races; Vic eyes a unit with nefarious undertones; Moe operates at less than full strength. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - The Empire Strikes Out
programme.desc: S2E21 - In Ontario, Calif., Jarrod overpays for some toys and Darrell has an encounter with "the Man"; Barry faces his own mortality. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Does a Bear Bid in the Woods?
programme.desc: S15E18 - Kenny makes his way out to the mountains, watching out for cougars the whole time; Lisa scores on a small sister locker, but it's Brandi who gets the nomination for buyer of the week. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Granny Get Your Gun
programme.desc: S10E11 - Ivy can't get enough during a visit to Montebello, Calif.; Dave gets a taste of carnival fun; Brandi and Jarrod engage in some vintage-style shredding. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Value of the Dolls
programme.desc: S10E14 - Jarrod locates the party locker he has always wanted; Rene finds a new mobile business opportunity; Ivy's footwear makes a big impact. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Pin Up or Shut Up
programme.desc: S15E16 - Dusty and Lupe pedal their way to an auction but end up needing the truck; Darrell pins his hopes on a small locker for which he overpaid; Rene makes the most of the honeymoon unit, and things get a bit racy. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles, Documentary)

programme.title: Storage Wars - The Iceman Carveth
programme.desc: S3E3 - The bidders travel to Oxnard, Calif.; Dave seeks gold, but finds bronze; Jarrod fights a cold; Darrell and Brandon have a disagreement. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Squatters - House Under Siege
programme.desc: S1E16 - In Washington, three sisters call on Flash after squatters take over their late grandfather's property; the house has been transformed into a hoarder's den, the backyard into a full-blown junkyard, and squatters seem to appear at every turn; to take back the home, Flash sets his sights on the ringleader, hoping the rest will finally fall in line. (Reality)

programme.title: Squatters - Man of Many Names
programme.desc: S1E18 - A young Washington couple is shocked to find a man claiming tenancy in the home they're renovating; as mysterious packages addressed to dozens of names flood the property, Flash suspects something much bigger is brewing. (Reality)

programme.title: Squatters - Serial Intruders
programme.desc: S1E12 - In Washington, health issues forced Zachary out of his dream home; he rented it to seemingly trustworthy tenants-only to realize they were alleged serial squatters who stopped paying and refused to leave; in one of his toughest fights yet, can Flash and his team take this home back? (Reality)

programme.title: Squatters - Locked Out in Philly
programme.desc: S1E11 - During renovations, Andrew's Philadelphia home was taken over by squatters who moved in, changed the locks, and installed security cameras; what begins as a straightforward case quickly escalates into a tense standoff with authorities, as Flash and his team attempt to reclaim the property without any help from the neighborhood. (Reality)

programme.title: Squatters - Dream Home to War Zone
programme.desc: S1E8 - In Cleveland, Ray is ready to move back home-until he discovers an intruder linked to his previous tenant has taken over his house; when Flash and his team step inside, it's anything but a routine squatter removal job; the house is uninhabitable, and the danger runs far deeper than expected. (Reality)

programme.title: Squatters - Battle of Wits
programme.desc: S1E6 - When a stranger moves in and takes over the new home of Nabih and Kadeisha, Flash and his team are deployed to Dearborn, Michigan with one goal: out squat the squatter; but what starts as a straightforward job becomes a battle of endurance when the trespasser challenges Flash to see who can hold their ground the longest. (Reality)

programme.title: Squatters - The Scam-lord
programme.desc: S1E15 - Trey's dream home renovation turns into a nightmare when he discovers squatters have taken over his Atlanta property; after forcing out two occupants, he's left battling a defiant holdout and a brazen fake landlord scheme fueling the chaos; but when Flash and his team arrive, they quickly realize this case will require a very different approach. (Reality)

programme.title: Squatters - Lake House Hijack
programme.desc: S1E17 - When a man claims possession of a cherished family lake house in New York, Flash and his team race to reclaim it; convinced he knows the law, the combative squatter refuses to budge, escalating tensions at every turn; with Flash going undercover next door, can he gather the intel he needs to outsmart the squatter and take back the home? (Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Toxic Tensions
programme.desc: S9E15 - In Tennessee, a wrong-way confrontation at an apartment complex erupts into a shouting standoff with a surprising twist; in South Bend, Ind., a long-running feud over dogs, trash and surveillance turns toxic when one neighbor resorts to biological warfare; in Austin, Texas, a hallway dispute spirals from noise complaints into a battle of doorbell camera taunts. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Mailbox Mayhem
programme.desc: S9E13 - In Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, a parking dispute escalates on the day a man is expecting an important delivery; in Pennsylvania, a landlord and tenant clash after a mailbox is replaced without permission; and in Brooksville, Florida, a woman's patience is in the crosshairs when her neighbor sets up a backyard shooting range. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Sun, Swim and Standoff
programme.desc: S6E31 - A pool party causes parking issues with the neighbors and throws the street into chaos; random dogs in a yard cause issues; a woman is proud of her seasonal house decorations until one opinionated neighbor calls it graffiti. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Space Invaders
programme.desc: S9E14 - In Michigan, a dispute over shared driveway parking puts neighbors at odds; in Ohio, a simple mail mix-up sparks an outsized reaction; and in Chicago, a routine move-out inspection turns into a heated showdown between renters and their landlord. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - I Got You Checkmated
programme.desc: S7E6 - South Carolina roommates are subjected to a string of bizarre insults by a neighbor outside their home; neighbors turn ugly in Oklahoma City when an apparent handshake agreement to not park in front of each other's houses is ignored. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Girl, You Better Back Up
programme.desc: S5E6 - A Utah woman and her neighbor argue over the building's heating; a Brooklyn landlord's boyfriend breaks through a tenant's door with an ax; neighbors in rural Nebraska squabble over the property line dividing their homes. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - The Parent Slap
programme.desc: S5E2 - In Georgia, a parent slaps the school bus driver after the driver refuses to let her kids off the bus; a woman returns to her parked car to find it covered in dog poop; prize-winning anglers are accused of stuffing their catch with weights. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Trash Talk
programme.desc: S5E8 - An Illinois man accuses his neighbor of putting garbage in their shared apartment hallway; in Texas, neighbors scuffle apparently over the best spots to view a Fourth of July parade. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - It's All Downhill From Here
programme.desc: S6E1 - A San Francisco man blows his lid when some neighbors don't park properly on a steep hill; in Denver, a dog trainer claims her unwelcome puppy advice ends a friendship with the woman opposite; in Virginia, neighbors engage in a shouting match. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Actions Have Consequences
programme.desc: S6E4 - A St. Louis family is alarmed when a neighbor bangs on their door with a hammer; when their leaf blower disappears, two sisters in Virginia decide to confront the neighbors. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - My Lewd Neighbor
programme.desc: S7E11 - When a man installs a surveillance system at his East Coast beach house, the neighbor is so angry he drops his pants in protest; in Illinois, a man is awakened in the middle of the night by his elderly neighbor. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Ranting-Neighbor Repellant
programme.desc: S7E2 - A lakefront beach in Illinois becomes a battleground when two neighbors yell over who is allowed to be there; a California woman sprays disinfectant at her neighbor. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Open Door, Big Mistake (New)
programme.desc: S9E17 - In Chesterfield, Virginia, a downstairs neighbor confrontation over moving noise quickly escalates; in Florida, a family is shocked when their doorbell camera captures a neighbor entering their home uninvited; and in Glenwood, Iowa, a man springs into action when an active shooter threatens his neighbor's home. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars - Mind Your Business (New)
programme.desc: S9E18 - In Portland, Oregon, a man standing in his own driveway is questioned by a neighbor about why he's there; in South Carolina's Blue Ridge Mountains, a tense balcony dispute escalates when a husband steps in to defend his family; and in Michigan, a mother who feels constantly watched decides to fight back, drawing plenty of attention. programme.title: Carnival Eats - Attack of the Mac and Cheese
programme.desc: S8E6 - Noah Cappe arrives at the Kentucky State Fair; the Mac Ball Burger, featuring deep-fried homemade mac and cheese; the Fried Green Frank, the Derby Pie Pop and the Southern Slaw Sammie; the Mac Attack Taco; Sunday Dinner Pizza; Grilled S'more Melt. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - From Golden State to Gizzards
programme.desc: S2E10 - Jalapeño cheese skirt burger; cowboy campfire churros; a donut to die for; an onion dog as big as a head. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - From Fertile Fields to the Red River Valley
programme.desc: S3E21 - Noah visits Polk County, Minn., and enjoys the North Woods Sandwich and Barbe-chos; going to Red River Valley Fair for the Redneck Taco. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - The Hunt for Breaded Oktoberfest
programme.desc: S10E5 - Noah Cappe takes off to the Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta, where the flavors are just as sky-high as the balloons. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Munchies on the Go
programme.desc: S5E15 - The fairground wasn't made for forks and knives, so Noah Cappe is checking out the fork-free favorites and the hand-held carnival treats that keep people coming back. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Comfort
programme.desc: S2E3 - 12 of the best comfort foods served in restaurants across America; learning everything there is to know about making macaroni and cheese, spaghetti and meatballs, pork chops and gravy, chicken and waffles, chili and more. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Hidden Treasures
programme.desc: S3E11 - Roger Mooking travels the U.S. to find classics with a twist and unexpectedly delicious pairings; he visits the chefs in their own kitchens to find out how they create these surprising and mouthwatering dishes. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Coastal Cuisine
programme.desc: S4E2 - Roger Mooking showcases some of the best of coastal cuisine in a top 15 countdown of the most delicious dishes inspired by America's oceans, lakes and rivers. There are wasabi salmon burgers in Alaska, crab cakes by the Chesapeake Bay and more. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Killer Combos
programme.desc: S4E1 - Roger Mooking explores the foods that are just too good together to be kept apart, showcasing 15 culinary combinations, like root beer floats and spaghetti and meatballs, that make mouths water and hearts race. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Kickin' Chicken
programme.desc: S15E8 - In Phoenix, a new contender in the chicken sandwich wars is topped with cheesy macaroni and spicy cheese puffs; Lollipop wings in Atlanta get smothered in gravy. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Neighborhood Hangouts
programme.desc: S14E49 - Neighborhood hangouts; elevated take on Gramma's meatloaf; Italian family tradition of Sunday gravy; Black Angus brisket and pulled pork. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Smokin'
programme.desc: S15E4 - The very best barbecue smokin' across America includes down-home dishes like spareribs and sausages, as well as new mind blowers like brisket mac and cheese and a smoky sandwich so big it's called the Leaning Tower of Texas. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Fried & True
programme.desc: S15E7 - A race to find foods that are fried and true, with unexpected dishes like chicken-fried brisket, fried lobster and a batter-dipped lasagna sandwich. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Swords and Spits
programme.desc: S5E4 - Roger visits chefs who use unusual tools over live fires; Erik Niel cooks rabbits rotisserie-style with bamboo poles; Chef Tim Byres of Smoke cooks flank steak and whole chickens on swords. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Hog Heaven
programme.desc: S5E5 - Roger cooks up two whole hogs in two different ways; Roger visits MOPHO restaurant for a Southeast Asian spit-roasted pig that is a twist on a classic tradition; Chef Miles McMath hinges two steel troughs together to make a quick-cooking oven. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Fireside Hangs
programme.desc: S5E6 - Chef Rob McDaniel at SpringHouse restaurant in Alexander City, Ala., roasts legs of lamb in a self-designed fire-fueled contraption; Cypress owner Craig Deihl prepares wood-fired food. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Fire Festivals
programme.desc: S6E14 - Roger visits a church picnic serving nearly four tons of meat; Roger stops by a Wisconsin winery, where they've built a contraption to roast a steer; Roger visits a New England fish festival, where they scorch 300 pounds of shad on upright boards. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Rad Rigs

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: After his father's demise, Charlie Price inherits the family business, a shoe factory in Northampton, England. He is not interested in shoes, and the factory is in such dire financial straits that he must lay off 15 employees. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers. - Joel Edgerton, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Sarah-Jane Potts, Jemima Rooper, Linda Bassett (Comedy drama, LGBTQ, Music)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. - Matthew McConaughey, Sarah Jessica Parker, Zooey Deschanel, Justin Bartha, Bradley Cooper (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
programme.desc: When the Mason family moves to idyllic Palos Verdes, Calif., the father, Phil, loves it but the mother, Sandy, feels out of place among the fake tans and tennis skirts. Phil and Sandy's daughter, Medina, is a loner and outcast at school, while her charismatic brother, Jim, is effortlessly popular. When Medina and Jim take up surfing, they must prove their right to share the waves with the tough Bayboys gang that monopolizes their stretch of beach. - Jennifer Garner, Maika Monroe, Cody Fern, Noah Silver, Justin Kirk (Comedy drama)

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: He doesn't know it, but everything in Truman Burbank's (Jim Carrey) life is part of a massive TV set. Executive producer Christof (Ed Harris) orchestrates "The Truman Show," a live broadcast of Truman's every move captured by hidden cameras. Christof tries to control Truman's mind, even removing his true love, Sylvia (Natascha McElhone), from the show and replacing her with Meryl (Laura Linney). As Truman gradually discovers the truth, however, he must decide whether to act on it. - Jim Carrey, Laura Linney, Noah Emmerich, Natascha McElhone, Holland Taylor (Dark comedy, Drama)

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. programme.title: Queen of the Desert

Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas. - Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen, Oliver Reed, Derek Jacobi (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Drama)

Jackson, Kerry Washington (Western, Drama, Action)

McBride, Isla Fisher (Comedy, Action)

programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs. - Barbra Streisand, Seth Rogen, Brett Cullen, Colin Hanks, Adam Scott (Comedy, Drama)

When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

When famous Italian-American bandleader Louis Prima is scheduled to appear at Paradise, the two brothers put all of their efforts into the important meal, which will likely decide the fate of their restaurant. - Minnie Driver, Ian Holm, Isabella Rossellini, Tony Shalhoub, Stanley Tucci (Drama)

Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life. - Naomi Watts, Bill Murray, Ann Dowd, Constance Wu, Sarah Pidgeon (Drama)
